1.1.0: Implemented multiselect input normalization for tools field.
2.0.0: BREAKING: upgraded @translated/lara-mcp 0.0.10 → 2.1.3, which fixes the command injection in the import_tmx tool (GHSA-xj5p-8h7g-76m7). import_tmx now takes tmx_content only (tmx_url and gzip were removed upstream); flows passing tmx_url must be updated. Adds detect_language and the glossary tools. Tool errors are now returned as isError results instead of JSON-RPC errors.
Security: upgraded @modelcontextprotocol/sdk to 1.32.2 (DNS rebinding, ReDoS and cross-client data leak advisories); the server package no longer nests an older SDK.
Security: pinned zod 4.6.6 as a direct dependency (memory exhaustion advisory in zod 3).
2.0.1: Fixed Call Tool Output: it is the tool's JSON result again (translate returns {"items": [...]}; 1.x returned a bare array). In 2.0.0 it held only the one-line summary that lara-mcp 2.x sends first, so the translation was lost.
